Corridor of the Ring
环指的走廊

dataList.content:
Why would you— If you didn't want to be friends with me, you could've just killed me. Why would you kill Fascia—
为什么……不想交朋友的话，只要杀我就好了。为什么连法西娅也……

I was getting to that part.
我正好也打算那么做。

Oh... It seems that my perspective was... severely lacking...
啊……我的目光……似乎太过短浅……

Please, forgive my disrespectfulness...
请宽恕我的无礼……

It is forgiven.
我宽恕你。

The air here is clean.
这里的空气相当清新呢。

I haven't breathed like this in so long.
我似乎可以久违地深呼吸了。
